parts:
Hello everyone,
I really need some information:
Can you help me to define the parameters of the item and test information function in the Multidimensional Confirmatory IRT?

library(mirt)
library(latticeExtra)

dfam <- mirt.model('
    pl = 1-9
    sb = 10-15
    db= 16-21
    dk= 22-28
    oy= 29-34
    COV = pl*sb, pl*db, pl*dk, pl*oy,
          sb*db, sb*dk, sb*oy,
          db*dk, db*oy,
          dk*oy')
abegom <- mirt(data=abegodatamh, model=dfam,
             method= "QMCEM", itemtype = 'graded',
             SE=FALSE, verbose=FALSE)
summary(abegom, suppress = 0.25)
abegm <- coef(abegom, IRTpars = TRUE, simplify = TRUE)
options(max.print = 1000000)
print(abegm, digits = 2)

testinfo and iteminfo ????

Thank you very much in advance

Arif
